title: operatorize-rbac-bootstrap-and-terraformize-policy-bundles-for-private
author: Markus Andersson
description: Consolidates tenant RBAC bootstrapping into a reconciling operator and adds Terraform modules + Helm hooks to wire policy bundles for Private deployments. Motivation: current bootstrap is a mix of ad-hoc scripts and one-off manifests which complicates automated upgrades and rollback in VPC/on-prem installs. This PR delivers: 1) a lightweight controller (operator) that watches Tenant CRs and ensures expected Roles/RoleBindings, ServiceAccounts, and PolicyBundle ConfigMaps are present and reconciled; 2) Terraform modules to provision initial tenant bootstrap artifacts as part of install pipelines (module inputs support tenant metadata, allowed namespaces, and admin principal lists); 3) Helm chart changes to add post-install hooks and annotations so the operator can claim Helm-reconciled resources; 4) idempotent rollback helpers and integration tests for upgrade/rollback scenarios; 5) docs and runbook for operators, including RBAC escalation boundaries and least-privilege guidelines. Checklist: [x] operator + controller code [x] Terraform module + examples [x] Helm hooks + chart values [x] integration tests (kind) [x] docs and runbook [x] security review signoff (limited scope). Related: ENG-4312, ENG-4399. This description intentionally keeps the narrative tight; see commits and changed_files for details.
